name: Summer Mountains (after Dong Yuan [active c. 937–75])
material: hanging scroll; ink and slight color on silk
summary: This monumental landscape is drawn in softly rounded strokes with darker lines frequently applied on top of lighter ones. This technique recalls one of the suggestions included in a collection of the artist's writings known as Secrets of Landscape Painting: The most difficult thing in painting is us
